'''Gi-an-ku'rii''' was a ritual among the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]]. During the ritual, Cathar warriors would expiate their shame.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
